entries.ff03ed18ae7b17e9: Its management philosophy is 'Trust first.' Its basic management approach is to build trust from customers through responding to quality and delivery requirements and continuing the post-construction 'CS survey'; trust from the community through locally rooted construction management and volunteer activities; trust from society through legal compliance, safety, environmental protection and information disclosure; and internal trust by having all employees pursue targets with a sense of ownership. In the medium to long term, it regards as important issues improving profitability through lower cost ratios and management rationalization, securing and developing human resources, raising corporate value through higher customer satisfaction and environmental protection, and strengthening its financial position.
